The Aurora Talons are known for maintaining no less than five "Master Bombardiers" in its command roster. Almost nothing else is known about this Chapter in current Imperial records.

page.overview:
What is Aurora Talons?

The Aurora Talons are known for maintaining no less than five "Master Bombardiers" in its command roster. Almost nothing else is known about this Chapter in current Imperial records.

The Aurora Talons' Chapter colours are not listed in current Imperial records.

The Aurora Talons' Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
